reviews.author: lounis lounis am
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this salon! The staff were professional, friendly, and welcoming. The service was excellent, and the attention to detail was impressive. The salon was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. I’m very happy with the results and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality service don't firget to look for David.Definitely coming back💇💆

reviews.author: Muhammad Ahmer
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Bhaiber Gents Salon! I got a manicure and pedicure, and the service was excellent. The staff was professional, friendly, and attentive to detail. Everything was clean and hygienic, and I felt relaxed throughout the service. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality grooming and excellent customer service. Will definitely visit again!
